kultivator.screen.help.bimbingan.title: Bimbingan Guru (Master Guidance)
kultivator.screen.help.bimbingan: The higher your realm, the faster your disciples cultivate while you meditate near them. A meditating disciple within 8 + 2 × your realm blocks (at most 24; realm counts from Mortal 0 to True Immortal 8) receives 10%% + 3%% × your realm + 5%% × the realms you stand above it of your own meditation gain (at most 60%%), and its own meditation runs ×(1 + 0.05 × your realm) meanwhile. A True Immortal master guiding a Qi Refining disciple gives 60%% within 24 blocks and ×1.4. The disciple's Status tab shows the numbers for that disciple. Sources: inspired by Battle Through the Heavens (Yao Lao, the teacher in Xiao Yan's ring, guiding his cultivation); the numbers are game design.
